headline: Gold falls as oil prices drop amid US-Iran talks
summary: Gold futures declined on Tuesday, tracking movements in crude oil prices as the United States and Iran engaged in diplomatic negotiations.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset whose price is heavily influenced by geopolitical developments, inflation expectations, and correlated commodity markets like crude oil.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Shifting geopolitical risk sentiment and lower oil prices reduce safe-haven demand for precious metals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Diplomatic talks between the US and Iran reduced geopolitical risk premiums, dragging down both crude oil and safe-haven gold prices.
